# Raspberry Pi Zero W boot configuration for otopi.
# Cut-down firmware: the GPU firmware only boots; vc4 KMS drives HDMI.
start_file=start_cd.elf
fixup_file=fixup_cd.dat
gpu_mem=16

kernel=zImage
dtoverlay=vc4-kms-v3d
disable_overscan=1

# PL011 UART on GPIO 14/15 for the serial console; Bluetooth is not used.
enable_uart=1
dtoverlay=disable-bt

# USB OTG port in device mode: Ethernet gadget (and rpiboot before that)
dtoverlay=dwc2,dr_mode=peripheral

# Faster boot
boot_delay=0
disable_splash=1
initial_turbo=30
avoid_warnings=1
